lines: Completely unaware of the meeting that was being conducted above, they had easily routed the security drones that had gathered.
However, they had been detected by the enemy. They probably couldn't stay here any longer.
「What's a familiar doing, wandering off without getting its master's permission?!! Shame on you!!」
「It's a master's duty to discipline her familiars. Don't interrupt!」
「Ah, it's true. Something black's coming this way. Whoa, that's some creepy movement.」
What had appeared, moving its six legs hectically, was a miniature multi-legged tank.
Miriam grabbed her two familiars and dove behind cover.
The multi-legged tank had opened fire without warning.
「My Evil Eye won't work against a tank.」
Clone Asagi, Aki and Nasara had also alertly hidden behind cover.
The turret on its back rotated, and tear gas grenades started being fired one after another, with dry explosive sounds.
The area was suddenly filled with pure-white tear gas.
「GS-500 tear gas, Secret Service Agency G's specialty. They never change.」
「(Cough, cough, cough!) Never mind the exposition!」
「Crap! I can't keep my eyes open!」
Clone Asagi, the cyborg, was fine, but the flesh-and-blood Aki and Miriam naturally seemed to be struggling.
On the other hand, Nasara, the Otherworld being, was calm.
「Looks like an AI tank specialized for anti-personnel suppression. Are you done yet, Mikoto?!」
Clone Asagi said to Mikoto, who was rummaging through the supplies even after things had reached this point.
「Ahh, hold on just a little longer♪」
「They've got tons of precious Demon Realm goods, worth hundreds of millions♪」
「(Cough, cough.) Isn't she in pain? Does she have some bizarre constitution?」
「Who knows? Maybe she's lost control of herself with greed. Or she's modified her own body so that she'll be fine.」
「Wh-Why don't we leave her to it and get out of here already? (Cough, cough, cough!)」
「She's the client, for better or worse, so we can't do that sort of thing. We'll buy her just a little more time!」
